about: ReDoS in AI guardrail regexes: five rules, naive vs hardened, five engines. Written by scripts/guardrail-redos/summarise.py from a measure.sh run.

rules.name: role_override
rules.what: chat-role spoofing line in retrieved text or user input

rules.name: secret_assign
rules.what: quoted credential assignment in model output

rules.name: exfil_url
rules.what: any http(s) URL with a dotted host, to check against an egress allowlist

rules.name: md_image
rules.what: markdown image pointing at a remote URL (zero-click exfiltration channel)

rules.name: pii_redact
rules.what: redact e-mail addresses and 16-digit card numbers before logging

benign_corpus.sources: GSM8K test questions and answers, TruthfulQA questions
